input.title: Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Silent night, except the snoring: a Frenchie ornament for the dog owner whose bulldog sleeps through Christmas morning louder than the carols, and an easy tree or stocking gift for a partner, a sister or the dog walker.

The print is a fawn French Bulldog with a dark mask and big upright bat ears, in a crooked red Santa hat, lying belly-down on a plaid tree skirt between two wrapped presents with its eyes shut and mouth open, a few z's rising above its head, with pine needles and a fallen red ornament beside it. SILENT NIGHT. sits above in cream capitals and EXCEPT THE SNORING. below in mustard, on a deep navy disc, with a cream outline around the dog.

It matches our Silent Night, Except the Snoring tee, so the tree and the Christmas-morning outfit can share one joke. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking or tie it to a gift for anyone who has been woken by a Frenchie snoring under the tree. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Glossy ceramic ornament, circle shape
  • 100% ceramic
  • Diameter: 2.76 in (7 cm)
  • Thickness: 0.125 in (3 mm)
  • Print on the front, white backing
  • Gold-colored string included
  • Blank product sourced from China

Each ornament is printed to order, so the color on your screen may differ slightly from the glaze.

Questions

What is the joke on the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament?
A fawn French Bulldog in a Santa hat sleeps belly-down between two presents with its mouth open, under SILENT NIGHT. EXCEPT THE SNORING. The Frenchie ornament from Graphic Tees Co. is for any dog owner who knows the carol and the snoring do not match.

What is the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament made of and how big is it?
The Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament from Graphic Tees Co. is a glossy 100% ceramic disc that is 2.76 inches (7 cm) across and 0.125 inches (3 mm) thick. The design is printed on the front, the back is plain white, and the finish is smooth and shiny, so the colors look bright on the tree.

How do I hang the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament?
The Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament comes with a gold-colored string already attached through the hole at the top. Loop it over a branch, a hook or a doorknob and it hangs straight. Keep it on a sturdy branch, away from the edge of the tree, because ceramic is heavier than plastic.

How do I care for the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament?
Ceramic is breakable, so handle the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament gently and do not drop it. To clean it, wipe the glossy front with a soft, damp cloth and dry it. Do not scrub it or put it in the dishwasher. Wrap it in tissue and store it in a small box between holidays.

Will the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament arrive in time for Christmas?
Graphic Tees Co. makes each Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament to order, and orders over $45 ship free in the US. For Christmas, order by about December 8 so it arrives with time to spare. It matches the Silent Night, Except the Snoring tee if you want a set.

What if the Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament arrives damaged?
Graphic Tees Co. sends a free replacement or a full refund if your Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Ornament arrives damaged, defective or misprinted, as our exchange policy describes. Take a photo of the ornament and the box and send it to us within 30 days of delivery, and we will make it right.
